_about: The self-recall count for City College of San Francisco report 28 (kb/_course_outcomes_read.py rows_recall). Report 28 names curriculum staff, so the trial filed no page (d-ccsf-outline-trial-no-staff-names-s689). Each count comes from the page itself: the trial printed each page's SLO section, cut by its STUDENT LEARNING OUTCOMES and CONTENTS headings alone, to its job log, and the worker counted the printed lines by eye, the lead not counted. The sandbox and the web fetch tool cannot reach ccsf.curricunet.com, so the runner's reading is the only one. No page prints an objectives heading (report 28 sits in REPORTS_WITHOUT_OBJECTIVES). Refreshed in S703 (d-ccsf-gate-refresh-by-free-trial-s703): trial 45018845370 read the same 12 pages under parser 2629a09aeac9be1183829d0cea92009f, every page answered 200 under both caps, and each count equals the one S690 made from trial 44744884314 under parser d5cef493.
